MeshPaintable3D uses 16-bit unorm UV buffer instead of Half float. Increases precision up to 32x without increasing memory since all 3d painted meshes have UVs in the 0-1 space. Fixes blotchy and jagged brush strokes. Also effects egg suit.

Lower quant from 1cm -> 1mm for position
- switch from sending delta position to sending quantized acceleration so we can keep 1 byte per update after moving to a 10x smaller quant

- will fine-tune values further

Send positions & rotations quantized
- reduce the 3x positions floats from 4 -> 1 bytes when they are within 1.27m per tick (1cm quantization)
- reduce the 3x rotations from 4 -> 1 byte when they are within 25 degrees per tick (0.2 degree quantization)
- will fine tune the values if it's too high a quant
- fallback to sending the full value when it changes by more than a delta
- tell the client what the quantization is so it can be changed during the session and be captured by demos

Store entity ID for position ticks in a 1000 sized cache
- reduces entity ID from 8 -> 5 -> 2 bytes (8 now, would be ~5 with VarInt encoding, 2 bytes with index lookup)

- demos store the network ID lookup in the keyframes so it can skip forwards & backwards still
- make batch position packets ordered now (not a big deal since they are way smaller than old ones and max one per server frame)
